test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A man has to cover a distance of 387 km in 21 hours. If he covers two - thirds of this distance in 5/7 of the time, then what should his speed (in km/hr) be to cover the remaining distance in the time left ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining distance = 1 − 2/3 = 1/3 of total distance = 387 ÷ 3 = 129 km.

Remaining time = 1 − 5/7 = 2/7 of total time = (2/7) × 21 = 6 hours.

Required Speed = Remaining Distance ÷ Remaining Time = 129 ÷ 6 = 21.5 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 21.5 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a9866dec188d98674b70b5c654eddb1c1492001531b4eb51594da1aa1e1f7ec.png] 

**Given:** Total distance = 387 km, Total time = 21 hours.

**Formula Used:** Speed = Distance ÷ Time

⇒ **Distance covered** = (2/3) × 387 = 258 km

⇒ **Remaining distance** = 387 − 258 = 129 km

⇒ **Time taken** = (5/7) × 21 = 15 hours

⇒ **Remaining time** = 21 − 15 = 6 hours

⇒ **Required Speed** = 129 ÷ 6 = 21.5 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 21.5 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Speed Formula

Speed is defined as the distance covered per unit time. Speed = Distance ÷ Time.

Average Speed

Average speed for the entire journey is calculated as Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
